effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] [On Deletion] If your opponent has 10 or fewer cards in their trash, trash the top 3 cards of both players' decks. Then, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in their trash, you may play 1 level 4 or lower [Evil] or [Fallen Angel] Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) for the turn. If your opponent has 10 or fewer cards in their trash, instead trash the top 2 cards of both players' decks.
